newsitem.title: UK: Late LME copper stable, stocks due up Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Late LME copper stable, stocks due up Tuesday.

text.p: Copper prices held steady up to the late close on Thursday amid tight nearby spreads and light speculative short-covering. By 1900 GMT three months delivery was hovering around $2,260 a tonne, little changed from its LME kerb close of $2,257 and around $20 up on Wednesday. By the close the cash/threes premium was steady at to $230, versus Wednesday's $207.

LME stocks on Friday are expected to register another increase, although traders doubt whether there will be a significant rise, as some metal will be removed from warehouses. A rise of between 5,000 and 10,000 tonnes is being talked about.
On the upside the market's major target remains the late-1996 peak of $2,313, traders added.
Aluminium lacked impetus to drive higher and dipped back to around $1,616, versus an earlier $1,622.50.
